about.title: About me
about.subtitle: Get to know me a little more!
about.paragraph1: Hi! I'm Alex, a passionate programmer, gamer and streamer in my free time. I mainly develop web pages and deploy servers of various types, although I have also created desktop applications.
about.paragraph2: I have a special fondness for experimenting with Node.js and other technologies. I spend many hours at my computer, working on various projects, always accompanied by my coffee and my enthusiasm for learning and discovering new things!
